datasetKey.description: Unique dataset identifier linking each occurrence record to its source dataset.

kingdom.description: Taxonomic kingdom of the organism is Animalia.

phylum.description: Arthropoda denotes the taxonomic phylum for each occurrence record.

class.description: Taxonomic class of the organism, consistently Insecta for all records.

verbatimScientificName.description: Scientific name of the recorded moth species.

verbatimScientificNameAuthorship.description: Scientific name authorship information, currently missing for all records.

countryCode.description: Country code of occurrence location, using ISO two‑letter abbreviations.

locality.description: Location information is missing for all records.

stateProvince.description: U.S. state or province where each occurrence was recorded.

individualCount.description: No data recorded for individual count in this dataset.

publishingOrgKey.description: Identifier of the organization that published the occurrence record.

decimalLatitude.description: Geographic latitude in decimal degrees for each occurrence record.

decimalLongitude.description: Geographic longitude expressed in decimal degrees, ranging from western United States to central Mexico.

coordinateUncertaintyInMeters.description: Spatial uncertainty radius in meters for each occurrence record.

coordinatePrecision.description: Coordinate precision data is missing for every occurrence record.

elevation.description: Elevation data not provided in this dataset.

elevationAccuracy.description: Elevation accuracy information is unavailable for all records.

depth.description: Depth values are unavailable for all records.

depthAccuracy.description: Depth measurement accuracy is unavailable for all records.

eventDate.description: Observation timestamps ranging from July 1978 to June 2026.

day.description: Day of month when the observation was recorded.

year.description: Calendar year of each occurrence record, ranging from 1978 to 2026.

taxonKey.description: Taxonomic identifier for Acontia cretata records, constant across the dataset.

speciesKey.description: Uniform species identifier for Acontia cretata records.

basisOfRecord.description: Record type is human observation for all entries.

institutionCode.description: Institution code identifying iNaturalist as the data source for each occurrence record.

collectionCode.description: Dataset collection type designated as observations for all records.

catalogNumber.description: Unique specimen identifier assigned by collection, ranging from six‑digit to nine‑digit numbers.

recordNumber.description: Record identifier field is entirely missing.

identifiedBy.description: Observer who recorded the occurrence, listed by name.

dateIdentified.description: Identification timestamp of each record, ranging from 2014 to 2026.

license.description: License type for each record, using Creative Commons identifiers.

rightsHolder.description: Rights holder names of individuals or organizations providing occurrence record permissions.

recordedBy.description: Observer names documenting each occurrence record.

typeStatus.description: Type status information is missing for all occurrence records.

establishmentMeans.description: Establishment means information is unavailable for all records.
